project.terraform-build-artifacts.impact: Configuration, state, and lockfiles are kept. Initialization may download dependencies again.

project.unity-build-artifacts.name: Unity build artifacts
project.unity-build-artifacts.description: Unity Library, Temp, Obj, and diagnostic folders.
project.unity-build-artifacts.impact: Assets and ProjectSettings are kept. Reimporting a project can take time.

project.unreal-build-artifacts.name: Unreal build artifacts
project.unreal-build-artifacts.description: Binaries, intermediate output, and derived-data cache in Unreal projects.
project.unreal-build-artifacts.impact: Project content and configuration are kept. Unreal regenerates the output.

project.cocoapods-build-artifacts.name: CocoaPods project dependencies
project.cocoapods-build-artifacts.description: The Pods folder installed from a project Podfile.
project.cocoapods-build-artifacts.impact: Source, Podfile, and lockfile are kept. Dependencies must be installed again.

project.haskell-build-artifacts.name: Haskell build artifacts
project.haskell-build-artifacts.description: Local Stack and Cabal build folders.
project.haskell-build-artifacts.impact: Haskell source and project configuration are kept. The next build recompiles targets.

project.composer-build-artifacts.name: Composer project dependencies
project.composer-build-artifacts.impact: Source files, composer.json, and lock files are kept. Dependencies need to be installed again.

project.jupyter-build-artifacts.name: Jupyter notebook checkpoints
project.jupyter-build-artifacts.description: Automatic checkpoint folders generated beside Jupyter notebooks.
project.jupyter-build-artifacts.impact: Notebooks are kept. Jupyter recreates checkpoints as you continue editing.

project.pixi-build-artifacts.name: Pixi project environment
project.pixi-build-artifacts.description: The local environment created for a Pixi project.
project.pixi-build-artifacts.impact: Source files, pixi.toml, and lock files are kept. The environment needs to be restored.

special.docker-build-cache.name: Docker build cache
special.docker-build-cache.description: Build cache that Docker reports as unused and not shared with an image.
special.docker-build-cache.impact: Images, containers, networks, and volumes are kept. Later builds may download or regenerate cache.

special.conda-cache.name: Conda download cache
special.conda-cache.description: Downloaded packages and temporary data reported by Conda.
special.conda-cache.impact: Environments and installed packages are kept. Conda may download these files again.

special.codex-archived-sessions.name: Older Codex archived sessions
special.codex-archived-sessions.description: Codex conversation archives not modified for 30 days.
special.codex-archived-sessions.impact: Only selected archived sessions are permanently removed. They cannot be reopened or recovered.

special.rust-toolchains.name: Additional Rust toolchains
special.rust-toolchains.description: Installed Rust versions not required by the default, active, override, or discovered project configuration.
special.rust-toolchains.impact: Only selected versions are uninstalled through rustup. Projects that still need them must download them again.

special.dropbox-cache.name: Dropbox temporary cache
special.dropbox-cache.description: Temporary upload, download, and recovery files discovered from Dropbox account locations.
special.dropbox-cache.impact: Dropbox must be fully closed. Synced files and account settings are kept; temporary files may be recreated.

special.windows-recycle-bin.name: Recycle Bin
special.windows-recycle-bin.description: All items in the current account's Windows Recycle Bin.
special.windows-recycle-bin.impact: Files and folders cannot be restored from the Recycle Bin after it is emptied. This item is never selected by default.

special.windows-system-logs.name: Windows log files
special.windows-system-logs.description: Setup, upgrade, and diagnostic logs older than three days under Panther, Logs, and System32\LogFiles in the Windows directory.
special.windows-system-logs.impact: Only fixed Windows log locations and log types are included. Files in use or unavailable to your account are skipped.

special.windows-internet-cache.name: Internet temporary files
special.windows-internet-cache.description: Temporary internet data that Windows reports as removable.
special.windows-internet-cache.impact: Saved passwords and browsing history are kept. Some pages may load again.

special.windows-delivery-optimization.name: Delivery Optimization files
special.windows-delivery-optimization.description: Update delivery cache that Windows no longer needs.
special.windows-delivery-optimization.impact: Installed updates are kept. Windows may download update data again.

special.windows-defender-cache.name: Microsoft Defender cache
special.windows-defender-cache.description: Temporary Defender data that Windows reports as removable.
special.windows-defender-cache.impact: Protection settings, quarantine, and current security definitions are kept.

special.windows-update-cleanup.name: Windows Update cleanup
special.windows-update-cleanup.description: Superseded update files that Windows reports as removable.
special.windows-update-cleanup.impact: Installed updates remain active. Removing old update files may limit rollback options.

special.macos-universal-binaries.name: Universal binaries
special.macos-universal-binaries.description: Extra Intel or Apple silicon code included in compatible Mac apps.
special.macos-universal-binaries.impact: Keeps the code needed by this Mac and checks each app before and after cleanup. Apps that are running or cannot be changed safely are skipped. Reinstall or update an app to restore support for both processor types.

actionMessages.blocked: Close the related applications and try again
actionMessages.previewed: Checks complete. No files were deleted
actionMessages.partial: Files in use or without permission were safely skipped
actionMessages.failed: Cleanup could not be completed. No other files were removed

actionReasons.itemsSkipped: Files in use or without permission were safely skipped
actionReasons.requiredToolUnavailable: The app or tool needed for this cleanup is unavailable. Nothing changed
actionReasons.preflightFailed: The selected files could not be checked safely. Nothing changed
actionReasons.executionFailed: Cleanup did not finish. No other files were removed
actionReasons.verificationFailed: Cleanup finished, but MangoDisk could not confirm the result. Scan again
actionReasons.cleanerUnavailable: This cleanup option is currently unavailable. Nothing changed
